metadata.question: Was the aerosol optical depth higher over the Gobi Desert in February 2020 than in February 2019?

data.raw_code: The question is about comparing aerosol optical depth (AOD) over the Gobi Desert between February 2020 and February 2019. 1. **Search Strategy**: - Collection: MODIS AOD products (MOD04_L2 or MYD04_L2) or VIIRS AOD - Location: Gobi Desert region (need to define a polygon around the Gobi Desert) - Time: February 2019 vs February 2020 2. **Masking Strategy**: - AOD products typically have quality flags. I should use the quality control bands to filter out poor quality retrievals. - MODIS has 'Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean' band and quality flags 3. **Logic**: - Calculate mean AOD for each period - Compare 2020 vs 2019 - Need to check for empty collections and valid pixels For MODIS AOD, I'll use MOD04_L2 (Terra) which has data since 2000. The key band is 'Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean' and quality control is 'Quality_Assurance_Land'. Let me define a polygon for the Gobi Desert region. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const gobiDesert = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[90, 45], [90, 40], [110, 40], [110, 45], [90, 45]] ]); const feb2019 = ['2019-02-01', '2019-03-01']; const feb2020 = ['2020-02-01', '2020-03-01']; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS AOD (Terra) const modisAOD = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD04_L2') .select('Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean') .filterBounds(gobiDesert); const aod2019 = modisAOD.filterDate(feb2019[0], feb2019[1]); const aod2020 = modisAOD.filterDate(feb2020[0], feb2020[1]); // Check collection sizes const count2019 = aod2019.size().getInfo(); const count2020 = aod2020.size().getInfo(); print(`2019 Images: ${count2019}, 2020 Images: ${count2020}`); if (count2019 === 0 || count2020 === 0) { print("C1"); return; } // Create mean composites const mean2019 = aod2019.mean().multiply(0.001); // Scale factor const mean2020 = aod2020.mean().multiply(0.001); // Calculate mean AOD values const stats2019 = mean2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: gobiDesert, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2020 = mean2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: gobiDesert, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const aodVal2019 = stats2019.get('Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean').getInfo(); const aodVal2020 = stats2020.get('Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean').getInfo(); // Check for valid pixels const countPixels2019 = mean2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: gobiDesert, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean').getInfo(); const countPixels2020 = mean2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: gobiDesert, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean').getInfo(); print(`AOD 2019: ${aodVal2019?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels: ${countPixels2019}`); print(`AOD 2020: ${aodVal2020?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels: ${countPixels2020}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (aodVal2019 === null || aodVal2020 === null || isNaN(aodVal2019) || isNaN(aodVal2020) || countPixels2019 === 0 || countPixels2020 === 0) { print("C2"); } else if (aodVal2019 < 0 || aodVal2020 < 0 || aodVal2019 > 5 || aodVal2020 > 5) { print("C3"); } else if (aodVal2020 > aodVal2019) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
